I've been taking my dogs to this place for a few years, but the owner or the person who receives the dogs is very rude. She answers in a dismissive way and, in my opinion, even disrespectfully. Every time I take my dogs there, I ask about the price because she's always changing it. Today, for example, when I dropped them off, she told me one price, and when I picked them up, she told me another. Let me clarify, they didn't have any knots, and it was just a basic grooming service. One dog weighs 3 pounds and the other 7 pounds, and that's not even the point. The way she answers is so rude; she acted like she was tired of my questions. Anyway, thank God there are many other groomers. I feel sorry for her because she always treats customers this way. I can only imagine how she treats her employees, who seem to be constantly changing, and I can understand why. This woman needs to have more professional ethics, more manners, and more respect.

DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG HERE — SPARE YOURSELF THE HEARTACHE.

Out of desperation, I took my dog ​​to this groomer after a visit to the dog park. Leaving him at this facility is one of my biggest regrets. When I picked him up five hours later, his eyes were bloodshot red, and he couldn't even open one of them due to the pain he was in. Another customer in the lobby even commented on how red his eyes were.

The old miserable lady at the front desk, who seemed completely incompetent and dismissive, gave the excuse that his red eyes were because he's a poodle and had “a lot of hair that went into his eyes.” How does that even make sense? That is not a valid reason for such clear suffering.

My only priority at that point was getting help for my dog, so I rushed him to the vet — and that's when I was told his cornea was scratched. On top of that, he had cuts on his legs and stomach that were never there before.

If you bring your pet here, you are literally paying for your dog to come out injured, neglected, abused, and in pain. I haven't stopped crying from the guilt and regret of bringing him to this place. The facility itself is run-down and outdated, and the lack of care and customer service says everything you need to know about how they treat animals.

After reading other reviews, I see I'm not alone. Please save your dog from this nightmare. Learn from my mistakes and avoid this place at all costs. This place should not be allowed to operate.

DON'T TAKE YOUR DOG HERE — SAVE YOURSELF THE PAIN AND ANGUISH.

Out of desperation, I took my dog ​​to this grooming salon after a visit to the park. Leaving him there was one of the biggest mistakes I've ever made. When I picked him up five hours later, his eyes were completely bloodshot, and he couldn't even open one of them because of the pain. Another customer in the waiting room even commented on how red his eyes were.

The bitter, elderly woman at reception, who seemed completely incompetent and dismissive, gave the excuse that his eyes were red because “he’s a poodle and had a lot of hair that got in his eyes.” How can that make any sense? That’s not a valid justification for the obvious suffering my dog ​​was going through.

At that point, my only priority was getting him help, so I rushed him to the vet—and there I was informed that he had a grazed cornea. He also had cuts on his paws and abdomen that weren’t there before.

If you bring your pet here, you are literally paying for them to leave injured, neglected, mistreated, and in pain. I haven’t stopped crying from the remorse and guilt for bringing him to this place. The facility is neglected, outdated, and the lack of care and customer service says it all.
